train_online_dpo_model: train a language model using Online DPO with custom reward functions and vLLM generation
generate_completions_vllm: generate completions using vLLM with server or colocate mode for fast online sampling
calculate_rewards: calculate rewards from multiple reward functions including model-based and custom callable rewards
configure_online_dpo_trainer: configure an OnlineDPOTrainer with PEFT, gradient checkpointing, and distributed training support
sync_model_weights_vllm: sync trained model weights to vLLM with FSDP and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 parameter gathering support
